original.question: Jerry wuxuu tuurayaa dharbaaxo lixeed. Waa maxay farqiga (oo loo qeexay dhibco boqolley) ee u dhexeeya inuu tuuro tiro ka weyn 3 iyo inuu tuuro laba jeeg ah oo isku xigta?
original.answer:
Waxaa jira 3 tirooyin ka weyn 3 dharbaaxada, sidaas darteed fursadda in mid ka mid ah la tuuro waa 3/6=50%.
Fursadda in la tuuro hal tiro jeeg waa 50%, sidaas darteed fursadda in laba isku xigta la tuuro waa 50% * 50% = 25%.
Farqiga u dhexeeya labadan fursadood waa 50% - 25% = 25%.
